title: Side quests without stepping on toes
tagline: Small tasks that come up while the main work goes on, each in its own worktree.
outcomes: Hand off small tasks without interrupting a pair
Give each one its own git worktree and branch

lessons.title: Why side quests get in the way

quiz.question: Why give a side quest its own worktree instead of the coder's checkout?
options: Two agents in one checkout switch branches and commit each other's half-finished changes
quiz.why: A worktree is its own folder on its own branch, so the side quest can't touch the pair's work, and it lands as its own small pull request.
